terms.gloss: a woodland pasture, wooded upland with open grazing
evidence: Varr. RR 2.3.6: silvestribus saltibus dēlectantur (Lewis & Short)
Verg. G. 3.143: saltibus in vacuīs pāscunt (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Defined by Aelius Gallus as a place of woods and pastures together: saltus est, ubi silvae et pāstiōnēs sunt (Festus, in Lewis & Short). Also a mountain pass. Latin has no one word for a clearing: an open place in a wood is locus apertus.

phrases.english: they graze them in the empty glades
there are the woodland pastures and the lairs of wild beasts
